idea.title: Automating deployment without automating an unsafe rollback
idea.summary: A small manual GitHub Actions gate can automate an existing VPS release while keeping database migration recovery under explicit operator control.

context.goal: Close the remaining Step 65 production deployment automation gap while preserving the proven release procedure.
context.situation: The production API image, backup, migration, readiness, and frontend release already had manual runbooks, but no coordinated manual-gated workflow.
context.problem: A generic rollback to an old API can be unsafe after an incompatible migration, and a frontend released before API readiness can expose a mismatched contract.
context.investigation: The existing CI, GHCR image publisher, Compose services, backup script, migration script, Cloudflare Pages project, and Step 65 runbooks were traced before implementation.
context.decision: Require a passing CI run and verified digest for an exact main commit, serialize manual deployment, stop the old API, verify an off-server backup, migrate, require clean status and readiness, then publish the matching frontend. Restart the old API only when failure occurs before migration starts.
context.implementation: Added a manual deployment workflow and a short VPS release script using existing Compose backup and migration services. A disposable simulation exercised preflight, backup, migration, status, and success branches.
context.result: Local workflow/configuration checks and failure simulations passed. A fresh Docker build was blocked by package-registry timeouts, and the controlled live deployment/rehearsal is still required before Step 65 can close.

learning_points: A manual dispatch can be a practical approval boundary when a protected environment reviewer gate is unavailable.
The safe restart decision changes at the moment migration begins; after that, schema compatibility must be established before old code runs.
An immutable image digest, commit SHA, and frontend release marker give operators one release identity across components.
story_points: The deployment path already existed as tested manual steps and scripts.
The automation reused those steps and made backup and readiness hard gates.
Failure simulations showed backup failure restarts the old API, while migration and status failures leave it stopped.
The live rehearsal and Docker image build remain honest open evidence.
possible_angles: Where automatic rollback becomes unsafe during a database release.
How to add a manual deployment gate without adding a deployment platform.
